snippet.title: CATARACT - Autobattle Roguelite Deckbuilder | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Assemble your team, slot your cards in and survive the expeditions in this JRPG-inspired roguelike autobattler.

Wishlist CATARACT on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4727950/CATARACT__Autobattler_Roguelite_Deckbuilder/

Help us improve the game on Itch.io 💖Our prototype is available right there, on your browser : https://keur-collectif.itch.io/ 🖥

Want to share your feedback directly? Join our Discord to discuss the game with the devs and community : https://discord.com/invite/peEbXdbs7t 
We’d like to hear your suggestions!

We revealed CATARACT during AG French Direct Pre-Show 🔥 (btw huge thanks to William Bertin from Sourcing in the Rain for the slot 💞)
